name: court-replay
description: Local laptop-camera demo for recording pickleball sessions and replaying them.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:lan: LAN_MODE=true concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
